acceptanceCriteria: Add a bounded fixture regression for an unowned dirty file selected by ENCLOSING_PACKAGE.
Validate enclosing-package witnesses under their actual rule without weakening direct/path-reader/unbounded witness checks.
Retain focused tests and independent review; distinguish clean-worktree success from the dirty reproduction.
body: Observed with Go1.27.1, Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Tasksbuild202 in #389 source worktree. Full affected package run fails TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree at measure_test.go154: conformance/delta-v0/README.md yields a legitimate ENCLOSING_PACKAGE witness for go:github.com/Beamfall/corvint/conformance, but the test applies OwnerOf(dirtyPath) and demands a direct source owner. Existing Select/measure_test.go are unchanged from public25971bda1ca1664d8a546d751cb2bb9bbd454daf; isolated baseline reproduction NOT_RUN. Reproduce by adding a non-Go nested fixture/doc under an existing Go package and running go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/liveverify/affected -run TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree. Expected: validate ENCLOSING_PACKAGE against enclosing package contract; actual: unresolvable witness. Log /tmp/delta-all-provider-regressions.log. All eight provider suites and delta focused checks separately pass; preserve this failed dirty-worktree observation, do not relabel it a pass after commit.
title: Affected live-worktree test misclassifies ENCLOSING_PACKAGE witnesses as owned source paths
